observations: Gravity stations were ingested under the G-AID named-column contract.
Anomaly reported in this run: near-zone terrain-corrected Bouguer anomaly.
assumptions: User density 2.67 g/cm³ was applied to the simple slab.
Elevation datum orthometric was used as documented.
Near-zone Nagy terrain correction used DEM dem-valid (checksum fixture, cell size 25.0 m, coverage 1.0) inside 150.0 m radius.
uncertainty: Simple Bouguer omits terrain. Incomplete terrain correction can exceed many geological signals.
Terrain correction is limited to the bound DEM. Intermediate/far rings are skipped when coverage is incomplete.
Atmospheric correction is not applied. Hayford–Bowie compartments are not implemented.
Spherical far-zone treatment and global/adequate terrain coverage are excluded.
Polynomial residual order is a modelling choice.
recommendations: Confirm density with rock samples or a well-justified local value before modelling.
Do not treat residual highs/lows as drill targets.
Do not present this run as a full-convention Bouguer product.
not_established: Spherical far-zone treatment, Hayford–Bowie or equivalent geometry, global/adequate terrain coverage, and atmospheric correction are excluded.

files.formula: G-AID gravity contract 1.0: named columns + documented CRS/units

gravity_ingest_qc.json.assumptions: None. CRS, units, and mapping came from the file contract or a reviewed plan mapping.

gravity_freeair_qc.json.formula: Δg_FA = g_obs − γ_Somigliana + 0.3086 h  (Moritz 2000; h metres, g mGal)

gravity_bouguer_qc.json.terrain: not applied — simple Bouguer only. Near-zone terrain correction requires grav.terrain_near_zone with a documented DEM.
gravity_bouguer_qc.json.convention: simple Bouguer (infinite slab). Terrain correction is not applied.

near_zone_terrain_corrected_bouguer_qc.j.numerical_approximation: Vectorized Nagy 1966 eight-term prism kernel per DEM cell inside the near-zone window.
near_zone_terrain_corrected_bouguer_qc.j.convention: G-AID near-zone terrain-corrected Bouguer anomaly. Spherical far-zone treatment, Hayford–Bowie geometry, global coverage, and atmospheric correction are excluded.
near_zone_terrain_corrected_bouguer_qc.j.formula: Δg_NZTC = Δg_FA − 2πGρh [+ Bullard B if requested] + TC_Nagy(R or DEM extent). TC is |gz| of DEM−slab prisms (Nagy 1966) inside the near-zone window. Far-zone and intermediate-zone / Hayford–Bowie are not applied.
limitations: Terrain correction is limited to the configured DEM extent or radius.
Far-zone and intermediate-zone terrain effects are not included.
DEM cells outside the near-zone window are ignored.
No Earth curvature on the prism kernel itself (Bullard B is a separate optional term on the slab).
Not equivalent to Oasis montaj or any commercial full-convention Bouguer product.
Spherical far-zone treatment, Hayford–Bowie geometry, global coverage, and atmospheric correction are excluded.

interpretation_limit: A gravity anomaly is an observation. Overlay and colour scale do not prove geological causation.
